trust: Every digest names its source in digest_source: vendor-file (a .sha256.txt / SHA256SUMS published next to the asset by its vendor), vendor-listing (digest from the vendor's release page, also re-hashed by the resolver), pypi-json (PyPI JSON API, TLS only, cross-checked against Ghidra's own pypkg/dist where present). A component with status 'placeholder' carries the literal sha256 PLACEHOLDER-UNRESOLVED: the host was blocked for the resolver on 2026-10-14 [unverified]. tools/check_backend_pin.py --release (and the build) refuse any placeholder, so none can reach a release build. Resolve the placeholders in slice B10 from a networked CI run and mark them digest_source 'tofu' when the vendor publishes no digest.

python-windows.note: www.python.org returned HTTP 403 through the egress proxy on 2026-10-14 [unverified]. python.org publishes an MD5 and a sigstore/GPG signature per file; record the MD5 plus an own SHA-256 (tofu) in B10.

license_policy.rule: No GPL-family code beyond the entries below. This is an engineering policy gate enforced by tools/check_backend_pin.py and the builders; it is not a legal compliance statement. An entry covers a component only by id (match) and identical SPDX.

ghidriff.role: static diff engine, separate unmodified out-of-process program (python -I -m ghidriff)
ghidriff.rationale: The one GPL exception in the product rule: GPL-3.0, never imported or linked, shipped unmodified with the exact corresponding source tarball and a written source offer.

temurin-jdk.role: Java runtime required by Ghidra, embedded in the full bundle
temurin-jdk.approved_via: owner answered 'Yes, ship the JDK' directly in the Instance C session to the question 'May the zero-download bundle ship OpenJDK (Temurin, GPL-2.0-only WITH Classpath-exception-2.0)?'; Instance A separately reported the same owner answer in its session
temurin-jdk.rationale: Ghidra needs a JDK and the owner asked for a no-download bundle, which requires shipping a JRE. Owner approval recorded 2026-10-15 (see approved_via). Shipped unmodified as a separate runtime with its licence texts and a source offer.

ghidra-GPL-dir.role: Ghidra GPL/** directory (GNU demangler sources and binaries)
ghidra-GPL-dir.rationale: Stripped from the payload by default (strip.ghidra GPL/**, not in strip.keep). PatchTrace targets Windows PE, which uses Ghidra's Apache-licensed Microsoft demangler; GNU demangling of non-PE targets is lost. Shipping it needs explicit owner approval and a matching pin change.
